about.title: ABOUT FLOOFY
about.description: Floofy is a talented illustrator and streamer known for captivating artwork and fun live streams. With a passion for creativity and a unique artistic style, Floofy has built a dedicated following in the art community. Whether through digital illustrations or interactive streaming sessions, Floofy continues to inspire and entertain audiences worldwide.

commission.title: COMMISSION
commission.description: Commission your own custom artwork from Floofy, tailored to your preferences and specifications.

streaming.title: STREAMING
streaming.description: Join Floofy live for art streams, Q&A, and community fun! Check out the streaming schedule and never miss a session.

reviews.title: REVIEWS
reviews.description: Read what others have to say about their commissions and experiences with Floofy! Your feedback is important—share your own review and help others discover the quality and creativity of Floofy's work.

donate.title: DONATE
donate.description: Support Floofy's creative journey! Your donation helps keep the art and streams coming, funds new projects, and shows your appreciation for the work. Every contribution, big or small, makes a difference—thank you for being part of the community!

contact.title: CONTACT
contact.description: Have a question, want to discuss a project, or need info about a special commission? Reach out to Floofy—your message is always welcome! Use the contact page to send your inquiry, and Floofy will get back to you as soon as possible.
